tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i dbang bskur legs par thob cing bsnyen sgrub la drod tshad thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ slob mar phrin las kyi bka' gtad bya 'dod na/ dur khrod la sogs pa drag po'i phrin las dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa mgul chings dang dri'i chus bkang la bshams/ de'i mthar 'byor ba'i gtor ma/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ phyag mtshan sogs skabs 'dir mkho ba mtha' dag 'du byas la/ bdag mdun las byang ltar bum pa'i nang du nag po chen po 'khor bcas bskyed la/ shā sa na dang*/ ka wu wa sogs bsnyen pa long dang bstun nas byas la/ slob ma rnams khrus nas phyung*/ mdun du brdar bas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis ji ltar 'tsham pa'i chos bshad kyis de'i kun slong bcos la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro ba'i phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// ma lus bka' drin bstsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas la/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ slar yang slob mas/ dpal he ru ka'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis bdag la dpal nag po chen po'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba bstsal du gsol/ gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma mgon po 'khor bcas las gzhung ltar bskyed la/ slob dpon he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon dang*/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su mgon po gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal dang*/ mchod rten chos bzang chen po sprin gyi yang rdzong dang*/ bi ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis byon nas/ rnal 'byor pa khyed rnams kyis bar chad ni ngas sel/ dngos grub thams cad ni ngas sbyin/

khyed rnams kyi srung ma dam pa bdag gis bgyid do zhes gsungs shing*| srid pa gsum g.yo 'gul rdeg pa'i cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas te slob ma rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams su sib sib thim par gyur par slob dpon gnyis kas mos te/ gu gul sha chen sogs sbyar ba'i spos bsregs/ rol chen bcas slob dpon gyis ka wu wa'i mjug tu/ badz+ra ma hā kā lā s+ya kā ya ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra tsa la ye hūm̐ ha āḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams brgya brjod cing ḍā dril gnas so sor bskyod la yun ring du dkrol/ de nas de nyid tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rjes rgyas btab la/ slar brtan byed chu dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje sa gsol btab la/ bum pa mgon po dngos su gsal ba slob ma'i mgor bzhag /rol chen bya zhing/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pas// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing bum chu khar sbyin/ de'i tshe bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa nyams su myong*/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang tha mi dad pa'i mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku yi rjes su gnang ba thob/ zag bcas dngos por 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ slar gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gong ltar 'don pa bsgyur la gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sngags btags pa dang*/

gnas pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rang rgyud de srog rnam bzhi la sogs pa sngags kyi rnam pa thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang 'od las grub pa'i ā di kā di kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam pa 'od 'phro ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ba spyan drangs/ slob ma ye shes kyi mgon por gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar bzhi snying gsum dril can gyis bskor ba la thim pas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lus can mi dang mi min thams cad sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing*/ 'byung ba bzhi yi sgra skad thams cad kyang grag stong sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar skad cig gis bsgrags pas phrin las mtha' dag thogs med du sgrub par byed pa'i nus mthu dang ldan par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam la/ slar spos dang rol mo bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyis/ ka wu wa 'i mjug tu/ wāka ā we sha ya sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod/ slar de nyid brtan par bya ba dang bzlas lung gi ched du/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i rna ba gnyis nas zhugs te snying khar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ gi mthar g.yas skor du zhugs par mos la/ mgon po'i rtsa sngags dang shā sa na'i rjes zlos gsum bya/ slar slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di la ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi snying po sngags kyi phrin las ma lus pa myur du 'grub par gyur cig / ces/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa me tog 'thor/ slar phreng ba gtad cing bdud rtsi blud/ hūm̐ */ rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu stobs dbang phyug gi// gsung gi dbang bskur bzlas brjod dzāpa kyi rgyun// rlung sngags snying po dbyer med dbyangs gsal dngos// rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur mchog stsol cig

| ces ka wu wa 'i mjug tu/ wāka a bhi ṣe ka ta btags la gtad/ des dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi snying po sngags kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ 'chal ba sgra la zhen pa'i ngag gi dri ma dag |dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi ngo bo sngags kyi rigs mtha' dag bzla ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /slar thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba sngar ltar btab la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kar phog pa'i tshe/ de las ye shes kyi mgon po mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig rgyang gis thon te/ slob ma'i smin mtshams su thim ma thag tu dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i rnam pa gri gug dang*/ thod khrag /ral gri/ rtse gsum la sogs pa dpag tu med pa rno ngar dang ldan pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar byon te slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du sib sib thim pa'i tshe/ slob ma rnams dpal ye shes kyi mgon po dang tha mi dad du gyur te gdod ma'i mgon po nyid ye shes kyi mgon por sgro btags pa'i 'khrul pa rtsad nas bcad de mnyam rjes gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos la/ spos rol sngar ltar las/ sngags mjug tu/ tsit+ta ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod la bstim/ spro na skabs 'dir phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur 'thad pas/ gri gug slob ma'i g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ */ stobs chen 'jigs byed gri gug rno// logs la drag po'i gsang sngags bkod| |mgon po 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'du// dgra bgegs sgrol phyir dbang bskur ro// badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya karta ri a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ thod khrag g.yon du gtad la/

hūm̐ */ skra dang bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru// dgra bgegs dmar gyis rab bkang ba// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rten// dngos grub thob phyir dbang bskur ro// zhes sngags mjug tu/ ka pā la ru dhī ra btags la sbyin/ ral gri g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ */ nag po chen po'i ye shes mtshon// ngar 'dzin nyon mongs gcod pa'i phyir// ye shes ma rig bral ba dang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang bskur ro// zhes dang sngags mjug tu / khaḍ+ga btags la sbyin/ rtse gsum thogs la/ hūm̐ */ rtse gsum rdo rje rno ngar bcas// dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i mdung*// dag pa'i sa gsum mthong ba'i mtshon| |sku gsum mthong phyir dbang bskur ro// zhes dang sngags mjug tu/ tri shū la btags la sbyin/ des dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mtshon byed phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ 'khrul pa dang bcas pa'i nga yir 'dzin pa'i yid kyi dri ma dag /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs rang rig pa'i ye shes stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ slar phrin las kyi bka' gtad byed na/ dpal gtor bris sku gdugs kyis brgyan pa dpal 'bar dang ldan pa/ mgon po dngos su gsal ba slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di nyid skad cig la dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa chen po rab tu 'jigs pa'i nang du/ dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho khol zhing dug gi rlangs pa phyogs brgyar 'phro ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gru gsum mthing ga'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal ba'i chos 'byung gi zur gsum du bka' sdod bya rog gi gdong pa can gsum dang*/ g.yas kyi zla gam la sha za seṅge'i gdong pa can dang*/ g.yon gyi zla gam la thugs yum dmar mo rtsa 'jib ma/

pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la khro chen brgyad/ khyams la nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gang po mdzes ma/ gnod sbyin khri/ pho nya sde brgyad sprul pa'i bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ gza' chen dgu la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i dregs byed du mas yongs su bskor ba'i steng gi nam mkhar 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ de'i 'og tu yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de ltar srung ma'i tshogs thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum dang bcas nas lus dang grib ma'i tshul ltar 'grogs nas/ ci bcol gyi gdong grogs chos ldan du bsgrub pa zhal gyis bzhes bzhin par gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas mos la/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje nag po chen po dpal he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog snying*/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ dgra bgegs kyi srog gcod/ dam nyams gyi gshed ma/ mna' zan gyi lings pa/ bka'i dge bsnyen chen po/ sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa khyod kyis/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu'i rnal 'byor/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ klu'i byang chub/ dus 'khor ba che chung*/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ rga lo tsā ba/ bde gshegs rdo rje rgyal po/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ rje spyan snga*/ rgyal ba gcung*/ bcu gnyis rdo rje rin chen/ 'dol ba grags pa rin chen rgyal ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ mgon gzhon pa/ rdo rje ye shes chen po paṇ+ḍi ta/

spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa/ mkhan chen brag gcog shar pa/ rje bsod nams bkra shis/ rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol/ mtshungs med rin chen dpal/ yongs 'dzin dam pa sangs rgyas rin chen la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig gi rim pa la gnas par gyis shig /khyad par nag po chen po khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon bdag gi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs shig /phrin las mngon du gyis shig /bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig /dpal dang grags pa sgrubs shig /rdo rje slob ma 'di'i sngon nas da lta'i bar thug pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon dam tshig nyams chag thams cad zhi bar gyis shig /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ khyad par du sgrub brgyud rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin rnams yun ring du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad dbyar dus kyi nyal 'gro ltar dar zhing rgyas par gyis shig /khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba rnams dang de dag gi longs spyod mnga' ris dpal yon 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i las dang*/ rjes su bsags pa'i snyan grags 'khor 'bangs mdor na mthun pa'i phyogs dang*/ bdag cag la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i khol po dang bran gyi las su dbang du bsdus shig /gal te snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dgra bgegs rnams zhi bas 'dul bar ma 'tshal na drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis brdegs shing spa bkong ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ rengs pa/ bskrad pa la sogs pa mngon spyod myur mgyogs kyi phrin las mngon du gyis la/ dgra bgegs log par lta ba mtha' dag tshar chod la byang chub kyi lam dam pa nyid du bkri bar gyis shig

/sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ ma hā kā lā tsa tur+hastaka sma rāya sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ya na rak+kan/ zhes brjod/ slar dpon slob thams cad thun mong du gsang ba gsol gdab kyis gsol ba gsum btab la/ gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing spos dang rol chen bya/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rkang brgyad bklags shing brjid chags par bya'o// de ltar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i phrin las bka' gtad gtor ma la brten nas bgyis pa'i mthu la brten dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nye bar bsnyen pa'i tshe rje ltar bkur zhing mchod/ sgrub pa'i tshe grogs ltar snying nye bar bya/ las sbyor rbad tshe bran khol po ltar dbang med du btang*/ de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshad ldan du nyams su blangs pas na/ chos skyong dam pa 'di ni gdon mi za bar srung ma mchog tu 'gyur zhing khyad par rdo rje slob dpon la ma gus pa nyung zad kyang mi bya ba dang*/ chos skyong la yid gnyis the tshom spangs nas blo ling gis bkal na/ srung ma dam pa 'dis ni mi bslu bar 'gyur ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang thub pa'i dbang po'i dam tshig gi rjes su byed pa nyid yin phyir/ des na da nas bzung ste chos skyong gi rten rdzas tshogs par bya zhing bsnyen sgrub las gsum gnad dang ldan pas rgyun gtor/ dus gtor/ 'phral gtor/ rtags gtor/ zor gtor te gtor ma lnga la nan tan du bya zhing*/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi khyad par gyi dam tshig thams cad srog la bab kyang mi btang bar bsrung ba dang*/ bya nag /khyi nag sogs mgon po'i rten du rung ba rnams la nam du yang rdeg rdung 'tshe ba spangs la 'bad pas sgrub par byos shig /de las 'das na khyod rnams la'ang nag po chen po khros pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig ches shin tu yul gnyan zhing lji bas bka' chad gnam lcags kyi thog lta bus myur du tshe srog 'gags shing*/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro//

zhes sogs dam tshig gi rnam gzhag dang*/ chos skyong gi zab khyad sogs rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gyis brda sprad/ de dag gis dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bka' gtad dang bcas pa legs par thob pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma lus pa srog dang mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /sogs gnyis dang*/ slar lus dang longs spyod thams cad rdo rje'i slob dpon la phul nas drug cha gcig dngos grub kyis slad du zhu snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ sho lo ka gcig po lan gsum brjod/ skabs 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ lhag ma bsdus pa slob dpon gyi kha chus bran la/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtsang sar dor/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rjes chog gzhung ltar byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar rdo rje nag po chen po'i rjes gnang phrin las lhun grub ces pa mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ bla ma khams skyo ba dkon mchog bzang pos yun ring po nas dgos gsungs par brten/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rig pa'i gnas lnga smra ba la snyengs pa med pa'i lo tsā ba chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ chu klung nā gardzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs gzhu smad spro lung gi kun dga' ra ba'i gzim chung dbang ldan pho brang du mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
